run_gen_build_yaml: run the script to generate YAML build dependency data for all proto files in src/proto
run_update_deps: run update_deps to recursively resolve import dependencies for a given proto file
review_update_deps: review update_deps to understand how it parses import statements and separates external google dependencies
refactor_update_deps: refactor update_deps to support additional external dependency prefixes beyond google/
summarize_main: summarize main to understand how it walks src/proto and outputs proto dependency YAML
